headline: Dawn of War IV December 3
title: Warhammer 40000 Dawn of War IV Release Date December 3 | Delayed From September | Gaming News
video_script: Warhammer forty thousand Dawn of War four is a real time strategy game from Deep Silver and KING Art Games. It was delayed from September seventeenth and now launches on December third, on PC through Steam. Commander Edition owners get in early on November thirtieth. Which faction will you play? Comment below!
description: Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War IV (Deep Silver / KING Art Games) was delayed from September 17 to December 3, 2026 on PC via Steam; Commander Edition gets access November 30. Sources: Gematsu, Steam store page.
